scientific_integrity: Analytical weakly null Weyl packets prove infinite-dimensional claims; finite symbolic checks are corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The Fourier branch is an inclusion, not a full essential-spectrum equality. Positive measures with finite reciprocal-square-root moment only. Existing exact norm and noncompactness are prior results. No independent validation.
title: Fourier essential-spectrum branch and reflection dichotomy for generalized Hilbert matrices
